answer: The design leans on time-locked work history, diluted when peers disagree, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. The river is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the beacon. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the jade of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
